methods.name: 2SLS / IV: coefficients, classical and HC1 SEs, first-stage (weak-instrument) F, Sargan; first-stage diagnostics; missing values
methods.reference: AER::ivreg; AER::summary.ivreg(diagnostics = TRUE) (ivdiag: weak-instrument F = partial F of the excluded instruments); vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(type = 'HC1'); anova(lm(x ~ controls), lm(x ~ controls + instruments))
quantities: first-stage regression R2, adj. R2, instrument coefficients and SEs
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 294-500: coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6 relative, p-values 1e-6 relative or 1e-12 absolute; counts and df exact

methods.name: Panel estimators on data with missing cells and missing string/numeric entity ids: FE, RE, two-way HDFE, mean group; FEGLM, panel GLS, PVCM extraction
methods.reference: plm::plm(model = 'within' | 'random'), plm::pmg(model = 'mg') and fixest::feols on the complete rows of the columns each estimator uses
quantities: two-way HDFE coefficients and iid SEs
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 193-195: coefficients 1e-8, SE 1e-6 relative; counts exact. HDFE: MAP converges to rounding on this panel (R replica of hdfe.rs: 3e-15), so the deterministic tolerance applies

deviations.note: p2a reports the cross-entity standard deviation, not its standard error; only the mean-group coefficients are pinned (Tier 4)
